name: PayDC
short_description: PayDC is a cloud-based EHR and billing platform designed primarily for chiropractic practices.
long_description: PayDC is a cloud-based practice management and EHR system designed primarily for chiropractic practices, though it can be used by other specialties. The platform offers integrated SOAP notes, scheduling, billing, and claims submission. PayDC is known for its user-friendly interface and all-in-one approach, eliminating the need for separate billing software. Pricing starts around $149/month, making it accessible for solo and small group practices seeking an affordable, integrated solution.
one_liner: Cloud-based EHR and billing for chiropractic and small practices.
best_for: Chiropractic practices seeking all-in-one EHR and billing
Chiropractors wanting cloud-based solutions without server costs
Practices needing integrated SOAP notes and billing
Solo and small group chiropractic offices
